title:

*Not your flat*

And almost no similar units for sale at the time.
Most flats don't have all of that, so the record doesn't move them.

caption:
Saw an HDB flat sell for $1.818 million and quietly added $200,000 to your own price? 🏢

That flat had everything stacked: city fringe, above the 40th floor, about 94 years of lease left, and almost no similar units for sale at the time. Most flats don't have all of that, so the record doesn't move them.
